fusions.name: Under the Gorget
fusions.desc: Lunges at an enemy up to 4 tiles away and bites the throat beneath its plate, which deals 28 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach. The bite ignores armour.

fusions.name: Buckle Gnaw
fusions.desc: A bite at the fastenings that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 6% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Spiked Collar
fusions.desc: For 7 seconds, 40% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it. Each kill you make while it is active restores 5 health.

fusions.name: Closing Ranks
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 35%, you gain a shield worth 25% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. The effect grows 8% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies. Once every 30 seconds.
